purpose: Source configuration for finding new EO foundation-model releases beyond curated awesome lists.
policy: Discovery sources create candidates only. Public publication still requires primary-source evidence and output validation.

sources.query: ("Earth observation" OR "remote sensing" OR geospatial) AND ("foundation model" OR "foundation models" OR "vision-language" OR "multimodal")
sources.promotion_rule: Create a candidate when the title/abstract names a model, benchmark, dataset, or model version and includes a paper URL.

sources.query: remote sensing foundation model OR earth observation foundation model OR geospatial foundation model
sources.promotion_rule: Create a candidate only for official organization/user repositories with a paper, model card, or release tag.
Create a candidate when the model card links to a paper/project and describes modalities, license, and intended tasks.
Parse tables and bullets, deduplicate by strong source keys, then classify before publication.
Never publish from social/news text alone. Require a primary paper, code repository, model card, project page, or official release note.
